caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair centered on a plain, light beige background. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, showing the wood grain texture. It features a curved, horizontal backrest attached to vertical spindles, with five spindles, three of which have a decorative, turned pattern in their center. The chair has outward-curving armrests that connect to the seat and the backrest, and the seat is slightly rounded. Four cylindrical legs, each with turned detailing, support the chair, and the legs are connected by three horizontal stretchers, two of which are also turned and connect the front legs to the back legs, with an additional middle stretcher connecting the two side stretchers. The composition is symmetrical, and the chair's details are illustrated with careful attention to contours and shading to emphasize its three-dimensional form.
title: Chair
